name: Data.trace_heckeOnGood_eq
summary: Rigid labels let one twist every primitive label at each chosen place to a primitive label that occurs neither for V nor for V', agreeing with it off irreducible characteristic polynomials. On good forms p acts as p composed with e0; subtracting the twisted idempotents (which kill every eigenpart) and splitting by eigenparts, the trace becomes a sum of coefficients times sums <b_i, R(h) b_i> over orthonormal bases, where only group elements h with an irreducible characteristic polynomial at a chosen place survive; for these the comparison of simple trace formulas gives the same value on V and V'.

steps.claim: Let F be the finite set of eigensystems d whose eigenpart is nonzero on V or on V'.
steps.lean: let F := ((D.finite_eigenPart V ⊤).union (D.finite_eigenPart V' ⊤)).toFinset

steps.claim: For each eigensystem q choose pi_q in heckeAlgebra(D) acting, on every space, as the identity on the q-part and as 0 on the d-parts for d in F other than q.
steps.lean: choose π hb using (D.exists_hecke_proj_eigenPart · F)

steps.claim: For each q, p pi_q is the action of an element b_q of the group algebra of the elements of G_f trivial at the chosen places.
steps.lean: choose b e using (p * π · |>.2)

steps.claim: For each eigensystem q and chosen place w choose a map c -> Q_{q,w}(c) on polynomials over k_w such that: if c is a primitive label of degree r, then Q_{q,w}(c) is a primitive label of degree r outside occurringLabels(D, V, q, w) and occurringLabels(D, V', q, w); and labelIdem(c), labelIdem(Q_{q,w}(c)) have the same coefficient at every element with reducible characteristic polynomial. This applies exists_labelIdem_eq_off_irreducible with r = 3^(e+1), 9 | |k_w| - 1, and the two sets of occurring labels, which have at most one element each by HasRigidLabels(D, V) and HasRigidLabels(D, V').
steps.lean:
choose Q l c using fun q w ↦ (exists_labelIdem_eq_off_irreducible (D.card_rowIndex.trans
    D.r_pow.choose_spec) (D.dvd_card_resField_sub_one w).1 · (o q w) (o' q w))

steps.claim: For every space W with principalForms(D, W) finite-dimensional, whose occurring labels are among those of V or V' and whose eigenparts outside F vanish: the trace of heckeOnGood(D, W)(p) equals the trace on principalForms(D, W) of sum_{q in F} (p pi_q)_W composed with the action of e0(D) - sum_{c in goodTupleFamilies(D)} tupleIdem(RowIndex(D), (Q_{q,w}(c_w))_w).
steps.lean:
have E {s} W [Module.Finite ℂ (@D.principalForms _ s W)] (m : D.occurringLabels W ≤
    D.occurringLabels V ⊔ D.occurringLabels V' ∧ ∀ d ∉ F,
    D.eigenPart W d = ⊥ := by simp +contextual [F, top_inf_eq]) : trace ℂ _ (D.heckeOnGood W p) =
    trace ℂ _ (∑ q ∈ F, (p * π q).1 W * (D.principalRep W).asAlgebraHom
    (D.e₀ - ∑ c ∈ D.goodTupleFamilies, tupleIdem D.RowIndex fun w ↦ Q q w (c w))) :=
    ((trace_comp_comm' (rangeRestrict _) ((goodForms ..).subtype ∘ₗ _)).trans (congrArg
    _ (ext fun _ ↦ (D.isCentralProj_e₀.1.map _).isProj_range.codRestrict_apply_cod _))).symm.trans
    (congrArg _ (eqLocus_eq_top.1 (top_unique (D.iSup_eigenPart W ▸ iSup_le fun d v e ↦ by
    cases em' (d ∈ F); simp_all
    simp [-map_sub, hb _ d, principalRep_mem_eigenPart, *, apply_ite]
    simp; rw [← map_sum, sum_eq_zero fun c h ↦ ((mem_filter.1 (Fintype.mem_piFinset.1
      (mem_map_equiv.1 h) 0)).2.2.imp (l d ⟨0, ·⟩ _)).elim fun w a ↦ piTensorElem_apply_eq_zero _
      (by_contra (a.2 <| m.1 d _ ⟨a.1, v, e, ·⟩))]; simp; rfl))))
steps.typed_fact:
trace ℂ _ (D.heckeOnGood W p) =
    trace ℂ _ (∑ q ∈ F, (p * π q).1 W * (D.principalRep W).asAlgebraHom
    (D.e₀ - ∑ c ∈ D.goodTupleFamilies, tupleIdem D.RowIndex fun w ↦ Q q w (c w)))

steps.claim: The trace of p on goodForms(D, W), the image of the central idempotent e0(D), equals the trace of p_W composed with the action of e0(D) on principalForms(D, W).
steps.lean:
((trace_comp_comm' (rangeRestrict _) ((goodForms ..).subtype ∘ₗ _)).trans (congrArg
    _ (ext fun _ ↦ (D.isCentralProj_e₀.1.map _).isProj_range.codRestrict_apply_cod _))).symm.trans

steps.claim: It remains that the two endomorphisms agree on principalForms(D, W), which is the sum of its eigenparts; let v be in the d-part.
steps.lean:
(congrArg _ (eqLocus_eq_top.1 (top_unique (D.iSup_eigenPart W ▸ iSup_le fun d v e ↦ by
    cases em' (d ∈ F); simp_all
    simp [-map_sub, hb _ d, principalRep_mem_eigenPart, *, apply_ite]
    simp; rw [← map_sum, sum_eq_zero fun c h ↦ ((mem_filter.1 (Fintype.mem_piFinset.1
      (mem_map_equiv.1 h) 0)).2.2.imp (l d ⟨0, ·⟩ _)).elim fun w a ↦ piTensorElem_apply_eq_zero _
      (by_contra (a.2 <| m.1 d _ ⟨a.1, v, e, ·⟩))]; simp; rfl))))

steps.claim: If d is not in F, the d-part of W is 0, so v = 0 and both sides vanish.
steps.lean: cases em' (d ∈ F); simp_all

steps.claim: If d is in F: pi_q kills v for q other than d and fixes it for q = d, and the action of C[G(D)] preserves the d-part; so the sum reduces to p_W(e0 v) minus p_W of the twisted sum applied to v.
steps.lean: simp [-map_sub, hb _ d, principalRep_mem_eigenPart, *, apply_ite]

steps.claim: Each tupleIdem(RowIndex(D), (Q_{d,w}(c_w))_w), c a good family, kills v: c has a primitive label c_w at some chosen place w above g0, so Q_{d,w}(c_w) is a primitive label occurring neither for V nor for V' at d, hence not for W; its idempotent acting at w kills the d-part, and so does the tensor product.
steps.lean:
simp; rw [← map_sum, sum_eq_zero fun c h ↦ ((mem_filter.1 (Fintype.mem_piFinset.1
      (mem_map_equiv.1 h) 0)).2.2.imp (l d ⟨0, ·⟩ _)).elim fun w a ↦ piTensorElem_apply_eq_zero _
      (by_contra (a.2 <| m.1 d _ ⟨a.1, v, e, ·⟩))]; simp; rfl))))

steps.claim: Apply step 5 to V and to V'; write both traces as sums sum_i <b_i, T b_i> over orthonormal bases and expand the group-algebra elements over their supports. Both sides become sums over q in F, over g in G(D) weighted by the coefficient of e0(D) - sum_c tupleIdem(Q_q(c)) at g, and over h in the support of b_q, of sum_i <b_i, R(h liftResidue(g)) b_i>.
steps.lean:
simp [E V, E V', trace_eq_sum_inner _ (stdOrthonormalBasis ..), ← e, asAlgebraHom_eq_sum_support,
    inner_sum, inner_smul_right, univ.sum_comm, ← mul_sum, -MulMemClass.coe_mul]

steps.claim: It suffices to show, for each q in F, each g in G(D) where that coefficient is nonzero, and each h in the support of b_q (trivial at the chosen places), that sum_i <b_i, R(h liftResidue(g)) b_i> is the same for V and V'.
steps.lean: congr! 5 with q _ g h k

steps.claim: Some component g_i of g (i a chosen place) has irreducible characteristic polynomial: otherwise, by the choice of Q, the coefficients of e0(D) and of sum_c tupleIdem(Q_q(c)) at g agree and the coefficient vanishes.
steps.lean: let ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, Irreducible (g i).1.charpoly := by contrapose! h; simp [e₀, tupleIdem, ← c, h]

steps.claim: By the comparison of simple trace formulas for the element h liftResidue(g) and the level chosenLevel(D), with B = h2(D) and gap h(D), these sums are the same for every space whose type kernel is a cusp kernel of order h2(D) (true for V and V') and whose parameter has gap h(D); its hypotheses on E(D) (roots of unity of order 5040, evenly many infinite places) and on the sizes hold for the data. It remains: every element of h liftResidue(g) chosenLevel(D) has irreducible characteristic polynomial at some finite place.
steps.lean:
refine (Space.exists_trace_eq (h := k.1 * _) (B := D.h₂) (by cases D.m_pow; simp [towerDeg,
    P.card_infinitePlace_E, parity_simps, *]) (finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace D.E ▸
    D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound) ?_ _ D.h D.le_of_hasLogBound).elim fun _ Z ↦ by
    simp at Z; erw [Z, Z] <;> apply_rules [isCuspKernel_paramW]

steps.claim: Let x = h liftResidue(g) b with b in chosenLevel(D).
The component of liftResidue(g) b at the chosen place i is an integral matrix t in GL(O_w).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨t : GL _ (LocInt _), ht⟩ := mem_Kf_iff.1 (liftResidue g * b).2 (D.chosen i)

steps.claim: The reduction of t is g_i (b reduces to 1 and liftResidue(g) to g), so the characteristic polynomial of t reduces to that of g_i, which is irreducible.
steps.lean:
erw [← mul_one g, ← hb, ← reduceFamily_liftResidue g, ← map_mul, show reduceFamily _ _ i =
    _ from reduceAt_eq_of_atPlace ht.symm, charpoly_map] at hi

steps.claim: The reduction of liftResidue(g) b at the place i is the reduction of its component t.
steps.lean:
show reduceFamily _ _ i =
    _ from reduceAt_eq_of_atPlace ht.symm

steps.claim: Reduction commutes with taking the characteristic polynomial.
steps.lean: , charpoly_map] at hi

steps.claim: The component of x at the chosen place i is t, since h is trivial at the chosen places; its characteristic polynomial is the image of that of t.
steps.lean: constructor; erw [← ht.trans (c := Gf.atPlace _ _) (by simp [mem_trivialOn.1 k.2]), charpoly_map]

steps.claim: A monic polynomial over O_w whose reduction is irreducible is irreducible, also over the fraction field E_w; so x has irreducible characteristic polynomial at the chosen place i.
steps.lean:
exact t.1.charpoly_monic |> fun m ↦
    m.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map.1 (m.irreducible_of_irreducible_map _ _ hi)
